name: Oh My Zsh Plugins
description: Adds, removes, or replaces the plugins array in the remote user's .zshrc for Oh My Zsh.

add.description: Comma or space separated list of plugins to add, for example "git, zsh-autosuggestions". Existing plugins are preserved.

remove.description: Comma or space separated list of plugins to remove, for example "docker, kubectl".

set.description: Comma or space separated list that replaces the entire plugins array. Cannot be combined with 'add' or 'remove'.
